column1: # Native package formats. One row per release package. packaging/scripts/formats.sh
# is the one reader of this table; the scripts, the workflow and packaging/ci/*.js
# all go through it. Columns are tab-separated and named by the header line.
# {version} in a template is the version in the row's style: tilde (1.2.0~rc1,
# from native-version.sh) or plain (1.2.0rc1, tilde removed). target names the
# CI leg, os is the "ID VERSION_ID" of the build image's /etc/os-release, and
# native_fidelity 1 marks the leg that runs the calibrated native replay.
